label: On RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_2 present receipt holds and correlativity is concurrent actualization
paraphrase: Closed definitional result, attribution deferred: for every history, giving relation and reception predicate, when present-tense receipt is read as standing composition (standingReceipt, RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_2: z receives x's esse at t iff x's esse is received in z and x is present at t), the present-tense reading of reception holds, and correlativity of receiving and giving is equivalent to weak concurrent actualization 40a97664. So on this sense the present-tense reading costs nothing and correlativity is 40a97664 restated.
